ns2:course.label: Advanced Digital Projects Lab
ns2:course.description: Planning, designing, executing, and documenting a microcomputer-based project. Emphasis on hardware but special projects may require an equal emphasis on software. May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: ECE 385.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: ECE 385.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Not intended for Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
